api:
OV.Dom.ghostClick(event, bornMs) -> bool: true for the 2nd click of a double click (detail >= 2) on a button that appeared less than 600 ms ago. Never true for keyboard activation (detail 0).
OV.Dom.focusKey(node) -> a selector that matches exactly one node (data-*, #id, aria-label or a combination). If none is unique, returns a text key of the form T<U+241F>selector<U+241F>text<U+241F>ordinal. If neither works, returns null. OV.Dom.refocus(key, within?) accepts both forms.
OV.Dom tooltip() long-press no longer writes data-lp on nodes; it tracks them in a WeakSet instead.
OV.BaseUI.lostTopics(G, base, itemId, n) -> [topicId]: the research topics available in that base that would become unavailable if n units were sold. Read-only.
Base btn() options: pressed (sets aria-pressed), noTab (tabIndex -1; the shortcut key is shown only in the tooltip).
Base oneShot(e): each new trusted keyboard activation (detail 0) is accepted unless the key is auto-repeating. The 400 ms / detail > 1 guard applies only to pointer clicks.
Base market keyboard, with focus on a row's Comprar/Vender button: Up/Down change row, PgUp/PgDn jump 6 rows, Left/Right change quantity (Shift = +/-10), Home sets 1, End sets the maximum (when selling: all), Enter buys or sells. The Comprar/Vender toggle has aria-pressed and role=group.
OV.GeoUI.model: alienBaseName(G, a), alienBaseTwin(G, a), alienBaseOther(G, a), waitSpeed(h) (3 = '30 min'; 4 = '1 hora' when h > 6), nightLineKey(phase, nt, asked) -> the '.short' key or null. targetName() now includes the race for alien bases.
G.ui.waitDay entries carry sped:true once the clock has been sped up. The geoscape resume() speeds up entries added from the briefing.
OV.CampaignUI.fmtDec1(v) -> one decimal in pt-PT ('51,2'; '50' stays '50'). Every campaign_ui button ignores ghost double-clicks.
New i18n keys: base.market.kbdHint.buy/.sell, base.market.rowKeys, base.market.needFor.one/.other, base.market.sellLast.title/.body.one/.body.other/.keep/.ok; geo.alienBase.nameRace/.nameNum/.shortNum, geo.ev.alienBaseFound.{patrol,agents,supply}.another, geo.toast.waitDay.fast, geo.ev.arrived.{night,dusk}{,.safe,.crash}.short. Changed wording: cp.br.waitDay.toast.
summary:
I fixed all 12 round-4 findings for fixer B; none were skipped. Each has a regression check in tools/tests/shell_persona_r4.test.js, qa/persona_r4_shell.mjs, or both.

Results:
- node tools/test.js --strict --i18n: 778 passed, 1 failed.
- The one failure is not in my files: ui_persona_r3.test.js, «atirador e alvo mais visíveis através das paredes». It belongs to the Battlescape fixer.
- Earlier in the session, some campaign_pacing, campaign_flow, battle_* and geo_wave4fix tests failed transiently while the other fixers were editing tuning.js, campaign.js and the battle files. Those failures are gone in the final run.
- qa/persona_r4_shell.mjs: 72/72.
- These also pass: base_ui_check 90/90, geo_check 36/36, campaign_flow_check 127 with 0 failures, persona_r1_shell 85/85, persona_r2_shell 122/122, persona_r3_shell 113/113, and ui_wave4_check 74 checks.
- qa/full_campaign.mjs failed on the first run because the browser closed mid-run, most likely from CPU contention with the other agents. The rerun passed: «campanha completa sem erros».

Per finding:
- #0 Double click on «REPETIR A MISSÃO» lands on «EQUIPAR»: fixed. Every campaign_ui button now calls OV.Dom.ghostClick, so a second click (detail >= 2) is ignored if the button appeared less than 600 ms earlier. Keyboard activation is never blocked. QA dispatches the double click on the briefing's «Equipar» and «Cancelar» and confirms the briefing stays open, while a single click still opens Equipar.
- #1 Selling the last corpse or artefact that research needs: fixed.
  - The sell row shows «◆ Necessário para investigar: Autópsia: Sectoide», using the new BaseUI.lostTopics, which runs researchAvailable with and without the item.
  - Selling the last unit, whether by «Vender» or «Tudo» then «Vender», opens a confirmation. «Guardar» is the default button and Enter keeps the item.
- #2 «Em construção» pushes the build list down: fixed. The section is now below the build list. QA confirms the Contenção row stays at the same y after a build starts.
- #3 Two identical «Base alienígena / Nigéria» rows: fixed.
  - Names and LOCAIS rows now include the race in the plural, e.g. «Base alienígena (Mutons, Nigéria)» and «Nigéria · Flutuantes».
  - A number is added only when two discovered bases share both race and place.
  - The discovery alert says «outra base alienígena (…), desta vez de Mutons» when another base is already known in the same place.
- #4 Focus jumps to «NOVO PROJETO»: fixed at the root.
  - The long-press no longer writes data-lp on every button; it uses a WeakSet.
  - focusKey now only returns a selector that matches exactly one node, otherwise the text-plus-ordinal key.
  - QA checks that every button in base tabs 2, 6, 7 and 8 is found again by its own key, and that two Enters on the scientist «+» give +2 with no dialog opening.
- #5 The oneShot guard swallows keyboard Enter: fixed. A new keyboard activation (detail 0) is always accepted; only auto-repeat is blocked. Two Enters on «Contratar +5» now hire 10, and a mouse double click still hires 5.
- #6 87 Tab stops in the Mercado: fixed.
  - Each row is one Tab stop: −, +, +10 and «Tudo» have tabIndex -1.
  - Keys on a row: ↑/↓ and PgUp/PgDn move between rows, ←/→ (Shift ±10) and Home/End set the quantity, Enter buys or sells.
  - Comprar/Vender have aria-pressed.
  - A keyboard hint line is shown and is hidden on touch devices.
- #7 iPad portrait: fixed.
  - Outside Instalações, the grid shrinks to 22 % with the meters beside it, and the facility card is hidden. The tab content height went from 520 px to 757 px.
  - Tapping a soldier scrolls the soldier card into view when it is below the fold.
- #8 «Esperar pelo dia» keeps the clock at 5 seg: fixed. The clock now rises to «30 min», or «1 hora» for waits over 6 h. This also happens when waiting from the briefing (via geoscape resume). The toast names the speed. QA confirms dawn arrives within a few real seconds.
- #9 The night advice is repeated twice: fixed. When the short question is shown, a new «.short» variant of the explanation is used and does not repeat «Esperar pelo dia» (night/dusk × normal/safe/crash).
- #10 «51.2/50» in the report: fixed with CampaignUI.fmtDec1, giving «51,2/50».
- #11 Rotating the iPad on «Local da primeira base» loses the site: fixed. A change in view.w/h during the place step now re-centres the globe on the chosen site after the free centre is recomputed. My first QA version passed even without the fix, so I changed it to double-tap the sea first, as the persona did. I confirmed it fails without the fix and passes with it.

Screenshots: I looked at 1440×900, 1024×576 (the 125 % case) and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834 with touch. They cover the market (buy, sell, sell confirmation), build list, research, soldiers and market in portrait, alien base alert and list, night arrival popup and dawn, briefing, and the base-location picker in landscape and portrait. They are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/persona_r4_shell/.
deviations: I ran one read-only `git status` by mistake. It changed nothing.
I updated one regex in my own round-3 test, tools/tests/shell_persona_r3.test.js, because the oneShot guard's declaration line now also declares keyRepeat.

integration_r3.test.js is not my file and was not edited. I kept the full night-line key expression in geo_ui.js so its regex still matches; the new .short variant is used only when the short question is shown.

Finding #6 suggested type-ahead or per-section jump keys. I did not add them, because the base already uses single letters (U, B, N, E, X, M, A). PgUp/PgDn (6 rows) and Home/End cover fast movement instead.
Finding #7 is solved with CSS only: in portrait, outside Instalações, the grid shrinks and the facility card is hidden. I did not add a «Ver base» button, so no new UI was introduced.
open_issues: The one remaining Node failure is ui_persona_r3.test.js, «atirador e alvo mais visíveis através das paredes». It belongs to the Battlescape fixer and is not caused by my files.

Waiting for dawn sets the clock to «30 min», but an unrelated alert (for example «OVNI detetado») drops it back to 5 seg, as in the original game. The wait itself stays queued, so the player must pick a faster speed again. If we want the speed restored automatically after such an alert while a wait is pending, that is a small geo_ui follow-up.

The first qa/full_campaign.mjs run failed with «Target page, context or browser has been closed» at 291 s, most likely from CPU contention with the other agents. The rerun passed: «campanha completa sem erros».
